subject: Inconsistent detailing of the sanitary vent stack at Room 214 between Plumbing Fixture

messages.text: The sanitary vent stack shown in Plumbing Fixture Schedule P-602 at Room 214 is not detailed consistently with Plumbing Riser Diagram P-501.
